title: Architecture
subtitle: How this portfolio is built & deployed

user.title: User Access
user.desc: Browser-based access via soominlab.com on ports 80/443 with full SSL encryption.

nginx.title: Nginx + Certbot
nginx.desc: Docker-based reverse proxy handling SSL termination via Let's Encrypt, serving soominlab.com and subdomains.

nextjs.title: Next.js 14 + R3F
nextjs.desc: React Three Fiber 3D portfolio app running on port 3000 inside a Docker container, deployed by k3s.

k3s.title: k3s + ArgoCD
k3s.desc: Lightweight single-node Kubernetes cluster. ArgoCD watches the GitOps repo and auto-syncs deployments.

jenkins.title: Jenkins CI
jenkins.desc: Automated pipeline: GitHub push → Docker build → GHCR push → GitOps repo update → ArgoCD auto-sync.

github.title: GitHub + GHCR
github.desc: Source code repository and Docker image registry (GitHub Container Registry). ArgoCD pulls images from here.

tailscale.title: Tailscale + UFW
tailscale.desc: WireGuard-based secure VPN for management access (SSH, k3s API, Hermes agent). UFW blocks all except 80/443.
